title: Phased model admission harmonizer for progressive rollouts
creator: Priya Malik
description: Implement a reusable policy engine and runtime controller that orchestrates phased admissions of model variants into production traffic. Supports traffic splits, timed step schedules, shadowing, A/B cohorts, and automatic rollback based on configurable telemetry guardrails.
background: Current rollout primitives are ad-hoc: customers configure static traffic percentages and use external scripts for gradual increases. We need a declarative, ergonomically-configured engine that guarantees safe, observable progressive exposure across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments.
goals: Provide a declarative rollout manifest for model admissions (traffic split + step schedule semantics)
Ensure automatic safety gates (latency, error-rate, quality regressions) with escalation and rollback actions
Enable shadow traffic and cohort-based A/B experiments with per-cohort metrics
Expose rollout state and telemetry in Console + API for auditability and manual overrides
scope: Phase 1: engine + runtime integration for HTTP generation endpoints (text/chat). Exclude embeddings, multi-model ensembles, and multi-region cross-traffic routing for now.
technical_approach: Build a policy compiler that converts a high-level rollout manifest into runtime steps: each step contains traffic proportions, duration, and guard thresholds. The controller executes steps using a staged-scheduler, subscribes to streaming telemetry, evaluates guard predicates in near real-time, and triggers automated revert if thresholds breach. For Private deployments, the controller runs in the customer's control plane image with pluggable metrics exporters. Use an extensible predicate DSL to support custom checks (SLOs, token-level latency p95, model delta on eval set).
telemetry_metrics: error rate (HTTP 5xx + internal model runtime exceptions)
quality delta on golden prompt set (BLEU-like / task-specific score)
request distribution by customer, route, and cohort
guardrails: Hard guard: error_rate > 1.0% sustained over 3m -> immediate rollback
Soft guard: p95 latency increase > 2x baseline for 5m -> pause step and escalate
Quality guard: regression on customer-specific eval > configurable threshold -> pause + create alert
Shadow probe: run % of traffic in shadow mode for safety probing before traffic shift
Burst protection: limit step increase to configurable max delta per step to avoid oscillation
rollback_policy: Default: immediate rollback to last known safe variant when a hard guard trips. Soft guards pause and hold at current distribution for operator review. Rollback includes routing back to previous model version and invalidating KV caches associated with the target model variant. Rollbacks emit audit events and create an incident ticket template with telemetry snapshots.
api_example:
manifest: 
  name: phased-admission-blue-green
  routes:
    - route: /v1/generate
      steps:
        - name: step-0-shadow
          duration: 10m
          traffic: {candidate: 0%, shadow: 10%}
          guards: [{type: latency, p95: 150ms, action: pause}]
        - name: canary-1
          duration: 30m
          traffic: {candidate: 5%, baseline: 95%}
          guards: [{type: error_rate, threshold: 0.8%, action: rollback}]
        - name: ramp-to-50
          duration: 2h
          traffic: {candidate: 50%, baseline: 50%}
          guards: [{type: quality_delta, threshold: -1.5%, action: pause}]
tasks: Design rollout DSL and open schema (contract with Console)
Implement policy compiler that generates step-level execution plan
Extend runtime router to accept dynamic traffic bindings and shadow descriptors
Integrate telemetry subscription pipeline (metrics + traces) with predicate evaluator
Implement rollback actions and audit event emission
Build Console UI for manifest authoring + live rollout visualization
Write e2e tests and chaos scenarios (node loss, latency spikes)
Prepare migration path for existing customers using static traffic configs
acceptance_criteria: Engine accepts declared manifest and executes step schedule on staging cluster
Guard predicates evaluated from live telemetry trigger pause/rollback as configured
Rollback restores previous model variant and KV cache invalidation observed in logs
Console shows step progress, per-cohort metrics and exposes manual override button
Integration tests simulate a quality regression and validate automated rollback
